503.issue_title: refactor: Require branch registration and state-derived PR targets

cycles.cycle_name: Explicit registration and non-mutating lifecycle contract cutover

deliverables.deliverable_name: Validated registration and one state mutation boundary
deliverables.description: Implement explicit parent propagation, complete fresh state initialization, validated stable-identity updates, one injected mutator/lock, single-slot repository parity and branch-state schema 2.0.0, with focused existing public behavior evidence.

deliverables.deliverable_name: State-authorized PR targets and scoped branch readers
deliverables.description: Use matching read-only registration for submit_pr head/base before lifecycle writes; require lower create_pr base; retain Ready/check-scope behavior and remove exhausted default-base authority.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Source-preserving validation and exhausted backup cleanup
deliverables.description: Remove automatic quarantine at the three agreed sites; preserve source, prior backup, diagnostic causes, successful planning writes and persisted readback facts; adapt existing behavior matrices and delete the unused backup command only after consumer closure.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Bounded consumer migration and verified active-runtime cutover
deliverables.description: Migrate affected code/fixtures/raw requests/Ready examples with at most one explicit setup helper, retire directly touched weak tests/ignored constructor argument, pass focused gates, and activate state 2.0.0 with identity/audit preservation and new-runtime context/health evidence.

cycles.exit_criteria: All four deliverables satisfy Design v0.1; meaningful source-preservation RED is confirmed before implementation, remaining structural coverage is reused; relevant focused test families and type-specific gates pass without known in-scope failures; no retired production authority remains; the active new runtime reads state2.0.0 with preserved identity/audit and the stored plan remains readable. No full suite, broad warning repair, release, compatibility bridge or phase progression without independent review.

deliverables.description: Remove the duplicate branch-keyed resolver expectation in favor of existing exact-branch coverage, correct the generic SubmitPR valid-input fixture and retire the obsolete base-cascade content test; add no replacement content or legacy-rejection tests.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Preserve planning-domain diagnosis through existing wrappers
deliverables.description: Remove PlanningMutationError from the two phase-tool catches and its exhausted import, retain PhaseEntryError handling, and prove normal/forced public wrapped calls preserve the original domain code, parameters and traceback using one focused behavior matrix in an existing test file.

cycles.exit_criteria: The three reported test-consumer failures are resolved under the current contract, normal and forced planning-domain errors reach the existing exception wrapper with original diagnostic facts, focused affected tests and type-specific gates pass, no new error architecture or compatibility path is introduced, and committed C_1 plus phase deliverables remain unchanged. Full configured suite and branch/configured gates are rerun only in renewed Validation after independent review.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Complete configured validation and preservation report
deliverables.description: Record final native-configured full suite, branch gates, configured production Mypy, deliverable/cleanup mapping, active-cutover evidence, warnings and truthful limitations in one durable report.
Reconcile project/GitHub/Git references and setup/upgrade guidance with explicit registration, source-preserving errors, state envelope2.0.0 and removed target defaults.
Update existing AGENTS source/tracked bundled copies and seven Ready examples proportionately; preserve role split and document current changes without a release/version promise.
